title: KHUJO - AI Integrated Mobile Theft Security System
shortDescription: KHUJO is a security system against second hand mobile phone syndicate in Bangladesh and mobile theft. People can drop a report of their stolen phone, search before buying if a second hand phone was stolen or not and helping real owner find their phone.
fullDescription: KHUJO is an innovative web security ecosystem created to dismantle second-hand mobile phone theft syndicates in Bangladesh. By uniting victims, buyers, and enforcement through a unified verification system, users can report lost devices, search stolen databases prior to buying used phones, and submit metadata leads to reunite owners with their lost devices.
recognition: Phase 2 participant of First AI Hackathon in Bangladesh by SOLVIO.
challenges: Ensuring privacy and integrity while allowing public verification without exposing sensitive user information.
Integrating Exif metadata extraction and AI validation to accurately match stolen device reports with marketplace listings.
Handling real-time alert notifications efficiently across distributed database triggers in Supabase.
futurePlans: Partner with local mobile retailers to provide instant QR-code device verification at point of sale.
Develop AI-powered OCR algorithms to automatically parse physical receipts and serial number barcodes.
Launch a mobile app with background security features and location-assisted recovery tracking.
